yamlCheck.dateAnchor: October (last week) departure, November (second week) squall, and mid-November arrival are spoken. The year and absolute opening/end dates come from YAML, not an independent spoken day number.
yamlCheck.explanation: The opening directly continues the prior aboleth aftermath. About a week of outfitting, an approximately two-and-a-half-week voyage and its nested night/squall anchors fit an October-to-mid-November span, but the return-to-port duration, precise departure day and intervening gaps are not fully measured. The transcript does not independently establish all 30 boundaries; YAML end is not used to fill them. The separate dated session record places departure October 23 and arrival November 13 (about three weeks), longer than the voyage wording; the review preserves that discrepancy without changing this transcript-only duration.
